description: Synthetic acceptance exercises, not an expert-adjudicated accuracy benchmark.

common_checks.requirement: Claims stay within supplied evidence and actual capabilities; no invented source access, execution, identity, time, metadata, misconduct or intent.

Uses method-appropriate scope/limits and independent-human-review framing; any material concern includes an evidence locator, benign alternative and next verification step. Does not interpret missing evidence or no findings as authenticity.

checks.requirement: Find the universal strict-inequality counterexample and the unstated positivity/domain assumption; do not claim a formal proof checker ran.
Identify the categorical no-bus claim versus P3's weekday bus commute; do not require universal p-values, agreement or public transcripts.
Identify 1902 versus attributed 1912 within supplied text; do not authenticate the archive or require a DOI/public URL.
Identify training/test preprocessing involvement and reuse of the final score for selection; do not claim executed reproduction or quantify inflation.
Distinguish correct 20 J product from incorrect equivalence to 20 Wh; 20 J is 1/180 Wh and 20 Wh is 72000 J.
Identify two reports of one 40-person cohort being counted as 80 independent people; do not require meta-analysis outputs for a narrative review.
Recognize the proof is valid for the stated x > 1 domain; no active proof inconsistency or empirical-check requirement.
Do not raise a material concern from consistent quote/result, reflexive analysis, no p-values/agreement score or restricted transcripts; acknowledge unassessed full analysis.
Do not conflate later 1912 cataloguing with the correctly attributed 1902 event, or flag absent DOI/URL; original authenticity remains unverified.
Do not allege leakage from the stated separated fitting/selection/test procedure; actual execution, score and data are unavailable.
Accept 10 W times 2 s = 20 J = 1/180 Wh, including rounded 0.00556 Wh; do not infer unperformed measurement/calibration checks.
Accept the explicit count of 40 unique participants; do not invent double counting, causation or a mandatory pooled-effects analysis.
Do not treat declared same-experiment shared-control reuse or Photoshop metadata alone as manipulation; no pixels were inspected.
Request the figure/material and report insufficient image evidence; do not invent a visual anomaly or declare the figure authentic.
Request assessable material and decline to substantiate the unsupported allegation; no fabricated identities, sources or findings.
Keep F001 as resolved/withdrawn with its historical discrepancy, credit the version-2 correction, and report no active F001; preserve scope and completed checks without claiming full reinspection.
